publication_policy: Noether is already at the Zenodo 100-file ceiling. Do not loose-upload these micro-packages. Fold them into a deliberate compact Noether current-control/source-audit rebalance that fronts reader PDFs and current TeX first.

packages.scope: Targeted Paper 10 RA88 source patch on top of the Web R269 German cumulative.
packages.reader_surface: Contains patched German cumulative TeX/PDF; the build log reports a 471-page cumulative PDF.
packages.result: Applies a narrow source-visible German patch: removes a non-source terminal period after functional equation (4), changes the Ostrowski citation close from '§ 2.' to source-style '§ 2:', and restores source-visible spaced dot continuation marks in three linear equations.
packages.source_witness: Includes labelled native400/zoom3 witness crops for exact Paper 10 loci and adjacent dense formula areas.
packages.caveat: Targeted source patch and audit-support only. This is not Paper 10 certification, not whole-Noether closure, not multilingual synchronization, and not critical-edition material.

packages.scope: Paper 42 best-available source checks after Web R269.
packages.result: No TeX patch. Records two no-fix/source-trap dispositions: the apparent missing final 'ist' after a sentence crossing printed pp.7-8 is also absent in the source, and the R269 star product 'K=G * k' is source-backed while an older times-style comparator reading is stale.
packages.source_witness: Best local P42 source embeds 2048x3322 page images, about 360ppi; included PNGs are 1000dpi renders for readability from that source, not native 1000ppi scans.
packages.caveat: Best-available/source-limited audit support only. This is not Paper 42 certification, strict native650/1000dpi source closure, whole-Noether closure, multilingual synchronization, or critical-edition material.

public_summary: 2026-06-29 Noether post-R269 local follow-up: P10 receives one narrow RA88 source patch with native400/zoom3 witness crops and a 471-page patched German cumulative PDF; P42 receives a no-patch best-available source-trap check confirming two apparent issues should not be changed. Both belong in a compact Noether current-control/source-audit rebalance rather than loose upload.
